passages.provision_quote: A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student, if the student is an unemancipated minor, of a request made by the student to change the student's: (1) name; or (2) pronoun, title, or word to identify the student.
passages.note: Enrolled text he voted to concur in: the parental-notification chapter requires notice regardless of a parental request and contains no permission-before-use requirement, so it matches the notify rung and excludes the ask-first and permission rungs; the bill's other part (pre-K–3 instruction) is a separate chapter, not an omnibus.
Roll Call 489, motion to concur in the enrolled version: Heaton is in the Yea list; 29 Nay, not near-unanimous.
passages.actor_quote: Y EA - 63 Abbott Goodrich Lyness Pressel Aylesworth Greene Manning Schaibley Baird Haggard May Slager Barrett Hall Mayfield Smaltz Behning Heaton
passages.tally_quote: Yea 63 Education matters Nay 29 Motion to Concur

passages.provision_quote: An employee or a staff member of a school may only use a name, pronoun, title, or other word to identify a student that is inconsistent with the student's sex if:
passages.note: Committee-amended version he remained co-author of required a parent's written request before staff use a different name (permission rung) plus notification; superseded by his later concurrence in the enrolled version that dropped the permission requirement.
Third-reading Yea; the engrossed text actually voted on is not in the sources, and the vote is superseded by the later concurrence vote on the enrolled text.
passages.actor_quote: Y EA - 65 Aylesworth Haggard Mayfield Slager Baird Hall McGuire Smaltz Barrett Heaton

passages.note: Introduced version he co-authored only restricted K–3 instruction on gender identity and said nothing about parental notification.

rows.reasoning: Heaton, a co-author of HB 1608 (2023), voted Yea (63–29) to concur in the enrolled act, whose operative section says "A school shall notify in writing at least one (1) parent of a student" of a student's request to change name or pronoun. That matches "Require schools to notify parents" and excludes notice only "when parents ask" and "parental permission before staff use a different name or pronouns"; the earlier committee version with a permission requirement is superseded by this later act.
